title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Fatigue and shortness of breath following recent hemodialysis.

HPI
The patient presents today for routine follow-up following maintenance hemodialysis. He reports feeling more fatigued than usual since his last dialysis session and notes increasing shortness of breath when ambulating. These symptoms are ongoing and have been progressive. He has a known history of end stage renal disease (ESRD) requiring regular dialysis treatments. He denies any fevers, chills, or chest pain.

Medication List
Maintenance dose of blood pressure medication. Phosphate binder taken three times daily with meals. Iron supplement as prescribed.

Exam
Vitals are stable. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Cardiopulmonary exam is unremarkable. Skin exam shows no new rashes or active wounds. Peripheral pulses are 2+ in all extremities.

Assessment
Patient with ESRD requiring maintenance hemodialysis. Symptoms of fatigue and dyspnea require further evaluation in the context of his end stage renal disease.

Plan
Continue maintenance hemodialysis as scheduled. Educate patient on monitoring for signs of fluid overload and shortness of breath. Advised patient to report any worsening symptoms prior to the next scheduled dialysis appointment.
explanations: ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.
Patient on dialysis: add Z99.2 dependence on renal dialysis.

distractors.why: Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
Dialysis status is reported with Z99.2.
